title: Add support for memory fill
body:
* Memory fill remembers the tuning value of the previous main tuning (with no fill values).
* Refactor composition format for fill:
  * Root property `fill` contains:
    * `global`: the global fill tuning spec (which deprecates `globalFill` in root.
    * `local`: a spec that allow enabling/disabling forefill, backfill and memory fill.
  * A new root property `initialTuningIndex` allow configuring the initial index from the tuning sequence. This allow setting a middle index that is initially affected by both forefill and backfill, but if memory fill is enabled, they will be replaced for some values by memory fill
* Add implement support for memory fill in `TuningSession`.
